{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, ensure all revenue strings are properly formatted
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for any remaining issues
print("After cleaning, revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head(10))

# Check for any invalid values (e.g., 999999.99) — QA orders
qa_check = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {len(qa_check)}")

# Confirm no QA orders remain
assert len(qa_check) == 0, "QA orders should not be in the data""}
